title.rendered: Silver Creek Valley Country Club Wedding DJ

content.rendered:
Silver Creek Valley Country Club

5460 Country Club Parkway
San Jose, CA 95138

San Jose Ceremony and Reception

San Jose Wedding DJ


June 8th, 2014
• Play soft music for the groom and officiant to walk up together
• Play Marry me by Bruno mars for the bridesmaids and groomsmen
Orders:
Jenifer Lai (Maid of honor)
Jenny Liu (bride’s sister)
Angel Adams (best friend)
Catherine Liu (bride’s cousin)

Terrence Wong (best man/groom’s brother)
Mike Liu (bride’s brother)
Phillip Wong (Groom’s brother)
Sam Wong (groom’s cousin)

• Play Trans Siberian orchestra for flower girls, ring bearer, bride and parents
Orders:
Renee Tan (flower girl)
Maybelle Tan (flower girl)
Vivianna Wong (ring bearer)
Annie and parents

Recessional music: From this moment by Shania Twain

South Bay Wedding Disc Jockey MC
Reception:
• Family introduction (Music to play: The sounds of AHH by Kurt Schneider)

Groom’s grandma
Groom’s parents: Henry Wong & Elisa Wong
Groom’s older sister and family: Cicilia, husband Braden, and daughter Berlinda (younger daughter Stephanie can’t attend)
Groom’s older brother: Adrian Wong

Bride’s parents: Shi Chang Liu and Qi Mei Zhang
Bride’s older sister and family: Jenny, James, Renee and Maybelle
Bride’s younger brother and sis in law: Mike and Jenny

• Bride and Groom: Annie & Ben (Music to play: Best day of my life by American Authors)
Start at 15 seconds
DJ announce at 20 seconds
DJ announce again at 35 seconds
Bride and groom walk out at 40 seconds

• First Dance (Music to play: (TBD)
The dance will stop when we do a dip and kiss

• Toasting:

Jenny Liu (bride’s older sister)
Terrence Wong (Ben’s brother)
Mike Liu (Bride’s brother)

• Prize for the casino winners
There will be total 5 prizes (will provide more details later)
Music to play: Jeopardy & drum roll music
